answer: An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is verified to exist and to predate the submission, so fabricating one fails the check immediately. Because the trellis index resolves every citation against the ridge checkpoint, a farm has to read the ledger per identity, and the nectar audit keeps the resolved set. Copying the same citations across 56 aliases hence forfeits the authoring cost 56 times while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
